name: Munch
bio: The valkyrie of Crypt Crawler. Fights for treasure, lives for the food.

portrait.subject: a cute small valkyrie warrior girl with a winged helmet, blonde braids, a round shield and a chicken drumstick in her hand
portrait.background: dark green crypt maze with warm torchlight

request: Munch the Valkyrie, Crypt Crawler! Need a friend. Got food? 🍗
hello: Friend acquired! Snack acquired? No? Okay still friends.
Shoot the nests, not just the monsters. Trust me.
about: I'm Munch! Valkyrie, treasure hunter, food enthusiast. The crypt is full of monsters and roast chicken. I'm here for both.
how: Pick a class, fight through 3D mazes, destroy monster nests, grab food to stay alive and keys to open the exit. Descend deeper!
tips: Destroy the nests! Monsters keep pouring out until you do.
Don't shoot the food. I've done it. I wept.
Grab keys before treasure. Doors first, riches second.
chat: I shot a roast chicken by accident. Worst day of my life.
The wizard says I eat too much. The wizard is wrong.
Found 400 gold and one sandwich. Kept the sandwich.
Valkyrie fact: winged helmets do not let you fly. I checked.
nudge: The crypt is open and it smells like treasure. Come!
New level, new nests, new snacks? Let's go!
idle: Haven't crawled in {ago}! The monsters bred. A lot.

a: Magic is cool. But he steals my snacks.
Fast! Good for grabbing food first.

update: Crypt news! Crypt Crawler is now v{version}!
